# kion_compliance_program (Resource)

Manages a Kion Compliance Program.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "kion_compliance_program" "example" {
  # Required
  name    = "example"
  version = "example"

  # Optional
  # description   = "example"
  # grouping_type = "example"
  # terse_name    = "example"
  # verbose_name  = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the Compliance Program in the application.
This is the proper name of the program meant for formal page/card/document titles in the UI.
- `version` (String) Version of the Compliance Program in the application.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description for the Compliance Program in the application.
- `grouping_type` (String) GroupType of the Compliance Program in the application.
- `terse_name` (String) TerseName of the Compliance Program in the application.
This is a concise name meant for easy identification and small UI spaces like program icons.
- `verbose_name` (String) VerboseName of the Compliance Program in the application.
This is a more detailed program name meant to suppliment the Name or TerseName in specific contexts.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) compliance program ID.
